evidence_excerpts: Dimidjian and Segal estimate, using the NIH stage model, that only 30% of research using mindfulness-based interventions has moved beyond Stage 1, with 20% at Stage 2a, 9% at Stage 2b, and only 1% conducted outside research contexts.
The article states that this is a woefully inadequate research base to inform whether MBIs are ready for use in regular clinical practice.
text: The clinical evidence base for mindfulness-based interventions remains insufficiently mature for broad routine clinical implementation.
